summary: Iteration 19 — Verified /my-account 12-token refactor and admin RBAC fix (super_admin acceptance). MyAccount page now shows EXACTLY 12 coloured pill tokens in the correct order with correct labels; each of the 11 content tokens switches to its matching panel; the Sign Out token opens an AlertDialog whose Cancel keeps the session and whose Confirm logs out, clears gz_token, and redirects to '/'. Profile panel shows real data (@—, email, name, DOB, address) with no ObjectId leak. Admin: super_admin can list Users (234) and Contests (52) at /admin/users and /admin/competitions — previously 403 'Admin only'. All 6 pytest cases + all 20+ Playwright assertions pass.
critical_code_review_comments: MyAccount.jsx is 599 lines — improved from iter17 (741) / iter18 (663) but still large; further extraction of Profile / KYC / Preferences / Referrals / Policies into standalone components under /components/account would keep this file below the 500-line comfort threshold and mirror the WalletPanel / SupportPanel / MyGamesPanel pattern already in use.

MyAccount.jsx line 105 uses `window.location.href = '/'` after logout — this triggers a full page reload rather than a SPA nav; navigate('/', { replace: true }) is cleaner and preserves any react-query cache invalidation timing, but the full reload is intentional here to nuke in-memory state — acceptable.

auth.py require_admin() line 121 now accepts four roles ('admin','super_admin','operator','support'). For sensitive mutations (delete user, promote roles, drain wallet), consider stricter guards — e.g. require_super_admin() specifically for role-changing endpoints so a 'support' agent can't escalate a user. Currently all admin routes appear to share the same guard.

MyAccount.jsx line 194 useEffect polling for Stripe topup returns 'session_id' status — polls every 2s up to 15 tries (30s). Fine, but tight-couples UI to Stripe. Move the polling logic into a hook `useStripeTopupStatus(sessionId)`.

Header still greets 'Hi, {name}' as a dropdown label — this is NOT the forbidden 'greeting hero' the spec called out (the spec removes the greeting card from the MyAccount body). Just noting the naming collision in case a future spec change targets the header too.

success_rate.backend: 100% (6/6 admin RBAC tests pass — /api/admin/stats, /api/admin/users, /api/admin/contests all return 200 for super_admin; unauthenticated request correctly returns 401/403; /api/users/me clean of _id)
success_rate.frontend: 100% for every review-request scenario: 12 tokens in correct order with correct labels; every panel switch works (11/11); signout dialog cancel keeps session; signout dialog confirm logs out + clears gz_token + redirects to '/'; profile shows real data with @-prefix or dash; no ObjectId visible; NO forbidden UI (no wallet-balance / active-tickets / orders / referrals stat cards, no 'Sign out → Admin' button, no tablist role); admin /admin/users shows 234 users, /admin/competitions shows 52 contests, no 'Admin only' error
